name: sok-surface-in-no-window
description: An own surface, which agent.surface answers, that is in no window fails the request with the text that names the surface, and sok sends no request for another window.
reason: The case answers agent.surface with a surface, and the process of the sok that the test starts belongs to no surface of a running application, so agent.surface refuses it.

error.message: surface terminal-9 is in no window
